title: Methodological Changes to the Attention ResUNet Hourly Precipitation Postprocessor
abstract: arXiv:2609.38609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This note is a technical companion to a previously published preprint describing an Attention Residual U-Net that postprocesses deterministic forecasts from The Weather Company's Global and Regional Atmospheric Forecast (GRAF) model into probabilistic hourly precipitation forecasts. It documents what has changed in that method since publication. Feature-wise Linear Modulation conditioning on calendar season and forecast lead time is used to produce a single trained model for each season, replacing 192 separately trained per-month, per-lead checkpoints. Lead time is extended from 48 to 72 h. Two new input channels are used, per-pixel local solar hour and a static, monthly-varying precipitation climatology. During verification, the climatological reference against which the Brier Skill Score is computed now has an added diurnal dimension, on top of the monthly resolution it already had. translated_title: Attention ResUNet 逐小时降水后处理方法的方法学更新
translated_abstract: 本说明是一篇已发表预印本的技术配套文档，该预印本描述了一个注意力残差 U-Net（Attention Residual U-Net），用于将 The Weather Company 的全球与区域大气预报（GRAF）模式的确定性预报后处理为概率化的逐小时降水预报。本文记录了自该预印本发表以来该方法的变化：现在采用基于日历季节和预报时效的特征级线性调制（FiLM）条件化，从而为每个季节训练一个单一模型，取代了原先按月、按时效分别训练的 192 个检查点；预报时效从 48 小时延长至 72 小时；新增了两个输入通道，即逐像素当地太阳时和一个静态的、随月份变化的降水气候态；在检验方面，用于计算 Brier 技巧评分的气候参考在原有月分辨率基础上增加了日变化维度；并对新旧版本的 Brier 技巧评分与可靠性进行了比较。
tldr: 该工作通过 FiLM 条件化将 192 个按月、按时效训练的模型整合为每季一个的单一模型，将预报时效延长至 72 小时，并新增当地太阳时与降水气候态输入通道及带日变化的气候参考检验，从而对 Attention ResUNet 逐小时降水概率后处理方法进行了重要改进。
en_tdlr: This update streamlines the Attention ResUNet hourly precipitation postprocessor by using FiLM conditioning to replace 192 separately trained checkpoints with a single model per season, extends forecast lead time to 72 h, and introduces local solar hour and precipitation climatology input channels along with a diurnally-resolved climatological reference for verification.
